description: A Hyperliquid wallet's highlight vs its whole record, from Hyperliquid's own public data: this week / 30 days / all-time P&L, how it did before this month, max drawdown, account value, and stats over recent closed trades (win rate, average win vs loss, worst trade). Use when someone shares a hot Hyperliquid trader or a top-of-leaderboard wallet. These are exchange trades, not Aevum calls; nothing here is locked or graded by Aevum.
